nodes.source: Della Santina CC, Potyagaylo V, Migliaccio AA, Minor LB, Carey JP. Orientation of human semicircular canals measured by three-dimensional multiplanar CT reconstruction. J Assoc Res Otolaryngol. 2005;6(3):191-206. Table 1B pooled mean unit normals, Reid frame (+X anterior, +Y left, +Z superior). Left-canal columns are the excitatory normals (table caption: a right-hand rotation about them excites). Right-canal columns in that table point in the inhibitory direction; the stored vector is their negation, so a positive dot product excites. Checked against the paper's worked examples for a nose-left yaw, a nose-down pitch, and a left-ear-up roll.
